composerInstructions: The right column and outer margins are brochure decoration, not geography. Render a worn old ski-holiday brochure with faded cream/blue/green/ochre print. Depict the lodge, service shed and tow at their existing surveyed locations as a former intact resort, then cross that resort group by hand with red marker. Do not add slopes, buildings, roads, people, countries, dates or prices. The avalanche footprint is real current geography, not a new event. Seep-line is damp ground, never a second stream.
